versions.changelog: Add native macOS support, Bash deployment scripts, Python environment detection, and offline dependency installation for UNIHIKER M10.

Initial release of unihiker-m10-python.

- Build, run, and troubleshoot Python programs on the UNIHIKER M10 using unihiker and PinPong APIs.
- Guides users through connection verification, Python environment selection, code generation, deployment, and troubleshooting.
- Supports display, buttons, onboard sensors, buzzer, GPIO, PWM/ADC, audio, and offline installation of Python dependencies when the M10 has no Internet.
- Enforces interaction and device safety rules; detailed step-by-step workflow.
